text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the winner's face, I was
really struck
by how radiant she looked
in her moment of
victory...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing everyone's smiles, but... it's

disappointing only being able to see
them
without getting to smile myself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: 次は見てるだけじゃない
笑うためにも、頑張ろう！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: 腹ごしらえしたら、作戦を立てよう

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work real hard after my
stomach's
nice and full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, okay. You're right. I'm going to do

everything I can so we can smile too
next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, no more moping! Here's to getting
even
stronger!
